claim_boundaries.constructed_center_only: The inherited centered coordinates use an algebraic origin reconstructed from edge vectors. They are not observed or labeled object, scene, camera or physical centers.
claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The inherited constructed pure-reflection correspondent remains a deterministic reference, not recovered fixture truth, an observed image, a counterfactual rollout or an independent measurement.
claim_boundaries.exactness_domain: Exact means equality over rational interpretations of pinned finite binary floating-point values. It does not authenticate source precision, physical truth, uncertainty or measurement accuracy.
claim_boundaries.localized_not_independent: The three focal-vertex identities per component are deterministic decompositions of the same inherited zero-sum coordinates. They are not independent samples, repeated measurements or evidence from three scenes.
claim_boundaries.no_matrix_tensor_invariance_or_spectral_: The component list is not assembled or interpreted as a matrix, tensor or physical inertia object. No coordinate, frame or translation invariance, spectral property, principal direction, eigenvalue or ranking is claimed.
claim_boundaries.no_vector_cross_product: All operations are ordinary products of two fixed scalar coordinates and finite sums. No 3D vector cross product, normal or orientation is computed.
claim_boundaries.not_primary_endpoint: Rows have no request-start, generated-horizon or executed-time correspondence. They are not r0,rhat,r and answer neither A7 nor any A1-A9 question.
claim_boundaries.products_not_physical_or_statistical_qua: Focal and complement coordinate products are retained only to localize a finite algebraic cancellation. Vertex names are fixed operand labels, not evidence of a physical or statistical vertex relation. The products are not covariance, variance, a population moment, interaction, association, physical scatter, inertia, distance, area, image footprint or metric evidence.
claim_boundaries.science_annotation_and_release: No raw bytes, labels, manifest, annotation eligibility, inference, forecast metric, current-state claim, stage gate, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_confounding: The three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population, representation or camera effect is estimated.

construction_semantics.centered_coordinate_formulas: The inherited exact algebraic origin uses a_c=(eAB+eAC)/3, b_c=(-2*eAB+eAC)/3 and c_c=(eAB-2*eAC)/3; each fixed coordinate sum is therefore checked as exactly zero.
construction_semantics.excluded_operations: No physical or statistical vertex relation, pairwise interaction, vector cross product, covariance, population moment, matrix or tensor interpretation, square root, eigendecomposition, normalization, tolerance, threshold, fitting, registration, classification or ranking is performed.
construction_semantics.fixed_order: A=banana,B=bowl,C=rubiks_cube with eAB=A-B,eAC=A-C,eBC=B-C. World component order is xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz; projected order is xx,xy,yy. The three algebraic vertices and all coordinate operands retain their inherited order.
construction_semantics.stored_coordinate_domain: Each finite retained edge coordinate is interpreted as its exact binary floating-point rational value. Integer numerator/denominator strings control equality; approximate numbers are display aids only.
construction_semantics.units_and_scope: World product records use stored m^2 units and projected records use stored px^2 units. These are frozen residual-vector coordinate products, not physical or image-object measurements.
construction_semantics.vertex_complement_identity: For each fixed coordinate pair p,q and each focal algebraic vertex, the q-coordinate sum of the other two vertices is checked as the exact negative of the focal q coordinate. The focal p coordinate times its own q coordinate therefore cancels the focal p coordinate times that two-vertex complement sum; the localized residual is checked exactly.

finding: All 162 world and 324 projected fixed-vertex complement identities have zero exact residual. The package serializes 1,944 exact rational records and revalidates all 648 Turn2856 exact records. This is a deterministic localized stored-coordinate algebra check only, not physical, statistical or scientific evidence.
